## Feature Report

### What Changed

- `tests/test_jev_ask_tool.py`: clear `no_proxy` and `NO_PROXY` inside the temporary environment used by the proxy-transport test, so an inherited bypass list cannot add a `"no"` entry to the HTTPS opener's proxy map.
- `tools/stamp_site_counts.py`: close a caught `HTTPError` before formatting the failure message, so its response wrapper does not emit a `ResourceWarning` when collected.
- `tests/test_release_resume.py`: raise this module's CLI subprocess timeout from 120s to 300s. No assertions change.

This carries over only the three test-hygiene changes from #2830. The plugin-bytecode fix that #2830 also contained already landed in #2810, so it is intentionally not part of this branch.

### Why This Exists

- The Jev test was environment-dependent. With `NO_PROXY` set, `urllib` includes a `"no"` key in the default proxy map used for the HTTPS opene
